name: Tegar Haris Damai Damarendra
title: Junior Software and AI Engineer
bio: Computer Science graduate interested in building practical software, from full-stack web applications to AI-powered tools and automated workflows. Working with React, Node.js, FastAPI, and Supabase, with experience integrating LLM APIs and automating processes with n8n.
longBio: Computer Science graduate with a strong interest in building practical software, from full-stack web applications to AI-powered tools and automated workflows. Comfortable working across the stack with React, Node.js, FastAPI, and Supabase, and familiar with integrating LLM APIs and automating processes with n8n. Also skilled in machine learning fundamentals, including audio-based emotion classification with deep learning. Detail-oriented and collaborative, with a focus on data quality, clear documentation, and clean, maintainable solutions.

education.thesis: Voice-Based Emotion Classification Using 1D Convolutional Neural Network and MFCC Features (Klasifikasi Emosi Berdasarkan Suara dengan 1D Convolutional Neural Network dan Fitur MFCC)

points: Annotated and quality-checked large-scale English datasets for AI training, meeting accuracy standards and deadlines.
Built a strong grasp of data quality and labeling consistency, applicable to LLM evaluation and RAG work.
Designed and developed a responsive company profile website using React and Tailwind CSS.
Built and managed the backend database using Supabase (PostgreSQL).
Designed and developed an automated Telegram chatbot prototype using n8n workflow automation.
Integrated the chatbot with an LLM API to generate efficient, data-driven, and interactive automated responses.
Configured Webhook and ngrok for real-time data exchange between the chatbot and backend services.
Tools: Google Apps Script (Sheet API), Gemini API, Python, n8n, Telegram Bot API, Webhook, ngrok.
